summary: Extended the TAIL-03 publication validator so --redaction and --all scan all 791 manifest-referenced document byte streams in addition to the publication packet.

Referenced documents are read from the current checkout, hash-checked against docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/release/tail-02/handoff-content.json, and rejected on missing, unreadable, hash-mismatched, or redaction-unsafe content.
Redaction failures report only path, line, and pattern class; matched values are not printed.
Normalized current manifest-referenced machine-local paths to repo-relative, policy-relative, or generic placeholders, then refreshed manifest hashes for the changed document bytes.
Updated TAIL-03 and #519 lifecycle truth surfaces so they no longer claim packet-only redaction coverage.

independent_redaction_audit.warning_reason: The generic CodeBuddy packet auditor expects run_manifest.json; TAIL-03 is a publication packet, so the issue-specific 791-document validator remains the authoritative denominator.

validation.purpose: Prove Ruby syntax for the changed validator.
Prove packet plus 791 manifest-referenced document redaction scan returns zero findings.
Prove negative fixtures reject integrity drift and redaction pattern classes without printing matched values.
Prove the complete final publication contract, including 791-of-791 manifest document scanning.
Prove refreshed manifest JSON is parseable.
Run independent deterministic packet redaction audit; no blockers were found.

non_goals_preserved: No merge, tag, release, or issue-close mutation.
No detected secret values are printed or retained.
No claim that a finite pattern scan proves absence of every possible private payload.
